messages.speaker: Tomas Silva
messages.content: QA found that updated prices still show the old value for several minutes. TKT-104 has the repro.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Invalidation on write only covers the single-product endpoint. The bulk price import path never deletes keys, so it waits for the TTL.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Short term, lower the catalog TTL from 300 to 120 seconds, and fix the bulk path to invalidate.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: I'll ship both. TTL change goes out with the bulk fix.
